questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Smoking is prohibited in public places as per the new law. Conclusions: I. People can smoke in private spaces. II. Smoking harms public health.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Smoking is prohibited in public places as per the new law.
Conclusions:
I. People can smoke in private spaces.
II. Smoking harms public health.
questions.solution:
(i) People can smoke in private spaces → Does not follow (The statement only talks about prohibition in public places; nothing is mentioned about private spaces.)

(ii) Smoking harms public health → Does not follow (The reason for the law is not stated.)

questions.question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: The Himalayas act as a natural barrier that prevents the monsoon winds from reaching the northern plains, thereby creating a dry region in the rain shadow area. Assumptions: I. The Himalayas prevent monsoon winds from reaching certain areas. II. The rain shadow effect leads to dry conditions in specific regions. III. Monsoon winds are the sole cause of rainfall in the northern plains.
questions.questionHtml:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.
Statement: The Himalayas act as a natural barrier that prevents the monsoon winds from reaching the northern plains, thereby creating a dry region in the rain shadow area.
Assumptions:
I. The Himalayas prevent monsoon winds from reaching certain areas.
II. The rain shadow effect leads to dry conditions in specific regions.
III. Monsoon winds are the sole cause of rainfall in the northern plains.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
options.html: Only I and II are implicit

options.text: Only II and III are implicit
options.html: Only II and III are implicit

questions.solution:
1.The Himalayas prevent monsoon winds from reaching certain areas - Implicit (The statement directly says the Himalayas act as a barrier preventing monsoon winds.)

2.The rain shadow effect leads to dry conditions in specific regions - Implicit (The statement links the rain shadow area with creation of a dry region.

questions.question: Identify the odd number: 1, 8, 27, 64, 121, 216
questions.questionHtml: Identify the odd number: 1, 8, 27, 64, 121, 216
questions.solution:
1 = 1 × 1 × 1 = 13

8 = 2 × 2 × 2 = 23

27 = 3 × 3 × 3 = 33

64 = 4 × 4 × 4 = 43

121 = 11 × 11 = 112

216 = 6 × 6 × 6 = 63

All numbers except 121 are perfect cubes

questions.question: If 2 @ 3 = 25 and 3 @ 4 = 49, what is 4 @ 5?
questions.solution:
Logic: The operation “@” is defined as a @ b = (a + b)²

4 @ 5 = (4 + 5)² = 9² = 81
